evidence.title: wmux README
evidence.locator: Install; Features (Bots, One prompt N worktrees, Phone, Git, Fleet, Browser, A2A, Survives quit, Usage limits); More table; FAQ
evidence.finding: ADE for AI agents on Windows and macOS: parallel agent panes, daemon surviving quit/crash/reboot, Fleet attention list, Multi Task fan-out into worktrees with hunk adoption, bots, Git page, iOS app, MCP tools, schedules, usage-limit pauses, MIT.

evidence.title: wmux LICENSE
evidence.finding: MIT license; the Mochi crew bot characters are all rights reserved (ASSETS-LICENSE.md).

evidence.title: Substrate security model
evidence.finding: Terminal substrate, not a data vault: per-user auth token on the pipe/socket, 0600 files on POSIX; confidentiality delegated to the OS; same-user adversaries out of scope.

evidence.title: Phone client contract
evidence.finding: Daemon-to-phone contract for terminals, approvals, answers and pushes; push notification payloads sealed by the daemon and relayed by the project Cloudflare Worker to APNs.

evidence.title: wmux push relay
evidence.locator: Why this exists; operator cannot read contents
evidence.finding: Stateless project-operated Cloudflare Worker forwarding already encrypted (AES-256-GCM, X25519) notifications to APNs; routing metadata is plain.

evidence.title: Self-host wmux for a team
evidence.finding: Docker/Traefik/oauth2-proxy recipe: one isolated headless wmux container per person with company OIDC sign-in, CPU/memory/process caps and dropped capabilities; no shared sessions.

evidence.title: Attach a remote machine workspaces
evidence.finding: Desktop attaches another machine live panes over a Tailscale-fronted wmux web connection, read-only by default and typing with --allow-input.

evidence.title: Schedule a prompt for one agent session
evidence.finding: Daemon-only prompt schedules bound to a PTY, incarnation and agent family; at-most-once claims; delivery only to a verified idle/waiting agent; repeats supported.

evidence.title: Scheduled run permissions
evidence.finding: Scheduled runs use Approval, Scoped, Auto (Claude) or Bypass modes; unanswered approvals end after 15 minutes; MCP tools dropped for unattended modes.

evidence.title: Hand work to another agent
evidence.finding: send_message and channel_post with a pane mention put text in an idle agent prompt; plain channel posts are notifications only.

evidence.title: Fan-out port and prepared worktree
evidence.finding: Fan-out turns one prompt into up to 8 tasks in git worktrees with a declared port range and setup command in wmux.json.

evidence.title: Public surface inventory
evidence.finding: Stable/experimental/internal RPC and MCP surface over Windows named pipe or Unix socket with auth token; TCP fallback; profiles full/core/commander.

evidence.title: wmux.app privacy policy
evidence.locator: The short version; The desktop app
evidence.finding: No backend holding user data and no accounts; desktop contacts the network for update checks (on by default, SHA-256 verified), optional Claude usage reads (automatic checks off by default), gh CLI PR status, a paired iPhone and the push relay (off by default); website uses cookieless Vercel Analytics; no analytics SDK in the iOS app.

evidence.title: Bot runtime
evidence.finding: One engine session per live bot with spawning/idle/running lifecycle and a turn queue; bots start Claude Code workers.

evidence.title: Fan-out service
evidence.finding: Orchestrates one prompt into N isolated worktree tasks; companion services adopt, close, gate and PR tasks (TaskAdoptService, TaskCloseService, TaskGateRunner, TaskPrService).

evidence.title: GitHub services over gh
evidence.finding: GitHub (and GitLab via glab) issue, PR, review and Actions operations run through the user gh CLI with argv and a rate-limit breaker; owner-approved acts only.

evidence.title: Daemon session manager
evidence.finding: Standalone daemon owns PTYs, supervised panes and recovery; AgentProcessTracker, PaneSupervisor and Watchdog modules.

evidence.title: Usage reserve
evidence.finding: When enabled, scheduled runs, fan-out workers and bot workers do not start while a Claude account 5-hour usage is above a threshold; typed input never gated.

evidence.title: Approval registry
evidence.finding: Daemon registry of approvals and ask-questions answerable from desktop or phone with deadlines and answer receipts.

evidence.title: Task ledger
evidence.finding: Daemon TaskLedger records delegated tasks and their delivery for agents.

evidence.title: SSH bootstrap for remote hosts
evidence.finding: Registry of attached remote workspaces and SSH bootstrap/tunnel supervision with tokens kept in remote-hosts.json.

evidence.title: wmux v4.16.0 release
evidence.finding: v4.16.0 assets: Windows Setup.exe and nupkg, Linux AppImage/deb/rpm, wmux-server Linux x64/arm64 tarballs; no macOS DMG in this release; v4.15.0 (2026-11-10) carried the arm64 DMG and macOS zip; earlier betas 2026-11-06 and 2026-11-10.

evidence.title: GitHub repository API
evidence.finding: 455 stars on 2026-11-16; MIT; default branch main pushed 2026-11-16; homepage https://wmux.app.

evidence.title: wmux.app llms.txt
evidence.finding: Platforms listed as Windows 10/11 x64, macOS Apple Silicon and iPhone companion; MIT open source; latest v4.16.0; no pricing page (404).

evidence.title: wmux for iOS on the App Store
evidence.finding: README links the free iOS app on the App Store; the privacy page says the former TestFlight beta form is retired because the app is available on the App Store.
